title: Nutty Chewy Indian Potato Bao
description: A light and flavorful Indian dish featuring potato buns with a nutty and chewy texture, perfect for a diabetic-friendly snack. This recipe combines the goodness of potatoes, nuts, and Indian spices to create a delicious and healthy treat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed potatoes, whole wheat flour, yeast, salt, and mix well.
Add the chopped almonds, chopped walnuts, ghee or oil, cumin seeds, coriander powder, and ginger paste to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 6-8 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place the circles on the preheated skillet or griddle and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned and puffed up.
Serve the Nutty Chewy Indian Potato Bao warm with your favorite chutney or sauce.
